# `kll_sketch_get_n_double`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
kll_sketch_get_n_double(expr)
```

Returns the number of items collected in the sketch.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT kll_sketch_get_n_double(kll_sketch_agg_double(col)) FROM VALUES (CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(2.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(3.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(4.0 AS DOUBLE)), (CAST(5.0 AS DOUBLE)) tab(col);
```

Result:

```text
5
```
